# Voice Of Customer Synthesis

Turn customer research into clear pains, triggers, objections, proof and messaging implications.

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

Turn customer notes, call transcripts, sales feedback, and research into PMM-ready voice-of-customer inputs: pains, triggers, status quo, JTBD, exact language, objections, proof, and messaging implications.

Example request:

> Use voice-of-customer-synthesis to improve this work using its complete upstream guidance.

Expected result: An output shaped by the complete upstream instructions, source material and the task at hand.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill voice-of-customer-synthesis
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/voice-of-customer-synthesis/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/voice-of-customer-synthesis/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
